notes.en: Every run is evaluated with the key of version 1.0, frozen on 2026-10-29 before any delivery went through it, and every file of the instance is public on GitHub. A delivery is judged by four judges that are not told which model or vendor made it: two read it against the planted items and two rate the report; a person settles the disagreements between the first two. An attempt lost before the model could deliver, to the lab or to the operator, is not scored and is rerun; each configuration shows how many. Claude Code ran on an Anthropic API key, billed to API credit, and some runs of 2026-11-09 on the owner's Claude subscription through a long-lived token, where the client's cost is the list price, not a charge. Codex ran with approvals and sandbox bypassed and OpenCode with its auto-approval flag, the series' exception to its rule against bypassing approvals, on a disposable machine with every decision counted.
